tools.name: reconcile_files
tools.description: Compare every CSV row by code. With no recipe, detect key and comparison columns and return the mapping for review. Exact unique normalized keys are final. Fuzzy matches remain unresolved suggestions. Results include matched rows, exceptions, totals, duplicates, SHA-256 source hashes and a reusable

tools.name: save_recipe
tools.description: Save only the recipe JSON, never files or URLs. Free: one recipe per workspace, replaced on each save. Keep the returned workspace_key private to read or replace it. Pro: unlimited recipes tied to the subscription token. Pass recipe_id to update a Pro recipe.

tools.name: run_recipe
tools.description: Apply an inline recipe or a saved recipe_id to this week's two exports. Return full counts and paged rows. Pro also saves 30 days of counts and source hashes, and returns the latest ten summaries. No raw files or row values are saved.

tools.name: explain_row
tools.description: Recompute the same files and recipe, then explain one logical CSV record. The header is record 1. Quoted newlines stay within one record. Supply the original files because the server keeps no rows.

tools.name: pro_status
tools.description: Check a Pro token, or see the free and Pro limits. Nothing is bought through this tool.
